Strait traffic has collapsed to ~6-10 transits/day against an 85/day baseline, emptying the corridor that generated the exposure, and Oman spent the period consenting to Western naval activity in its waters (UK/France navigation commitments 4 Jul, US mine clearance 25 Aug). Five of eight v1 tripwires unfired, all downward-if-absent; offsetting risk is the 5-6 Sep escalation (Iranian ballistic missiles at a US carrier, Iran's new prohibited zone).
